definitions.gloss: being at a loss; being stumped; being annoyed
definitions.explanation: A state of not knowing what to do, often because of someone's persistent or troublesome behavior. Expresses helpless frustration.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頑固|がんこ}→頑固：06643_ganko⟧さ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{閉口|へいこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'm fed up with his stubbornness.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{暑|あつ}さ→暑さ：12973_atsusa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{閉口|へいこう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was at my wit's end with this heat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{苦情|くじょう}→苦情：00252_kujou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}われて→言う：00515_iu⟧、⟦すっかり→すっかり：01270_sukkari⟧{閉口|へいこう}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I hear the same complaints every day and I'm completely fed up.

notes:
USAGE:
{閉口|へいこう} literally means "closing one's mouth" — being so overwhelmed or frustrated that one is speechless. It is used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ and often takes the pattern 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{閉口|へいこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{閉口|へいこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be fed up with ~
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{閉口|へいこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be really at a loss about ~

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {閉口|へいこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be stumped / fed up
- ⟦すっかり→すっかり：01270_sukkari⟧{閉口|へいこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be completely at a loss
- {閉口|へいこう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧: was at my wit's end

FORMS:
{閉|へい} (close) + {口|こう} (mouth). The image is of being so overwhelmed that one cannot even speak.
